name: tripmate
description: Group Travel Matcher: find travel companions, book one stay together, split it fairly.

scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.reset-db: node -e "for (const f of ['app.db','app.db-wal','app.db-shm']) require('fs').rmSync(f,{force:true}); console.log('Database removed; it is re-seeded from data/ on next start.')"
